attribution: Contains information from GeoNames, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution.
transformation: Current populated settlements and neighborhood areas with known admin1, including PPLX sections of populated places; additionally, source ID 2566582 Victoria Island (T/ISL) is retained as a source-backed hospitality area. No abandoned, destroyed or historical places. Primary labels preserved; ASCII alternate names retained. Source ADM2 labels retained as areas, without claiming official LGA coverage.
limitations: GeoNames is a maintained geographical gazetteer, not a guarantee of every Nigerian village, neighborhood or current administrative boundary. Duplicate names refer to distinct source records; city selectors deduplicate names within a state. Some records lack area metadata and most have no population value.
